title.narrative: Mali Meaningful Youth Participation (MYP) in SRHR

description.narrative: Cordaid provided technical assistance to the partner organization CAEB, implementing partners, youth leaders, religious and community leaders. Objectives Technical Assistance - Provide trainings on Meaningful youth participation (MYP) - provide trainings on SRHR - Develop, share and adapt learning/ teaching materials for SRHR and MYP - Capacity building on Monitoring and Evaluation - Assistance on data analysis and reporting - Assist in communication and advocacy on the global level for visibility and knowledge sharing purposes

From the perspective of the Cordaid role in the Jigiya project the beneficiaries are: - The selected Jeunes Leaders. - The targeted religious and traditional leaders from the target area - Staff of CAEB - Staff of the 6 implementign NGOs in Mopti and Segou region.

In Mali, sexual and reproductive health and rights of youth and women is inadequate. Due to restrictive and sometimes harmful socio-cultural norms, restricted legal frameworks and limited policy accountability, harmful traditional practices (like child marriage, female genital mutilation ), high maternal mortality, gender-inequality, limited access to srhr services, GBV persist. In order to promote a free choice, increase advocacy of youth on their SRHR and create a favorable environment for youth on SRHR, this project started.
